cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, is still preaching to the people about how to live and worship in the land God is giving them. Now he warns them about one kind of person. Say a prophet or dreamer of dreams arises among them and proclaims a sign or wonder.

cards.question: True or false: in Moses' example, the prophet's sign or wonder never comes about.
The prophet's sign or wonder comes about. Then what does he tell Israel to do?

answers.text: Follow other gods and worship them
Build an altar on every hill

cards.text: Gods Israel has not known, Moses says. The sign checks out, and then he wants them to follow total STRANGERS.

cards.question: The prophet's sign came true, but he's pushing other gods. What does Moses say Israel must do?
Moses says the LORD their God is ___ them, to find out whether they love Him with all their heart and all their soul.
Instead of following other gods, who does Moses say Israel is to follow?

cards.text: Then Moses piles it on: fear Him, keep His commandments, listen to His voice, serve Him and hold fast to Him. Not "hold loosely." Not "hold when it's convenient." HOLD. FAST.
Then it gets serious. Moses says that prophet or dreamer must be put to death.

cards.question: Why does Moses say the false prophet or dreamer must be put to death?

answers.text: He urged them to rebel against the LORD
He lied about the sign he gave
He claimed to be Israel's king

cards.question: True or false: Moses describes the LORD the prophet rebels against as the One who brought Israel out of Egypt and redeemed them from the house of slavery.

cards.text: And Moses lands it like this: "So you must purge the evil from among you."
Now Moses pictures a different voice. Somebody comes along saying, "Let us go and worship other gods" and it's the same old pitch with a brand new salesman.

cards.question: This time, who does Moses picture trying to pull someone toward other gods?

answers.text: Their own family or closest friend
A traveler from a far land
A priest serving at the altar

cards.question: True or false: Moses says this family member or friend tries to pull them in secretly.

cards.text: And the gods on offer could belong to the peoples around them, near or far, from one end of the earth to the other.
Moses says not to yield to him, not to listen to him, and to show him no pity. That's their own family, friend, and I think this one hurts.

cards.question: True or false: Moses says to spare and shield this family member or friend.
Moses says the one who secretly enticed must surely be put to death. Whose hand must be the first against him?

cards.text: Then the hands of all the people follow. Moses says to stone him for trying to turn them away from the LORD, and names Him again as the God who brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

cards.question: Moses says then all Israel will hear and be ___, and will never again do such a wicked thing among them.

cards.text: Now Moses zooms out from one house to a whole city. Say word comes that wicked men in one of Israel's cities have led their people astray, saying, "Let us go and serve other gods".

cards.question: When Israel hears that report about one of their cities, what does Moses say to do first?

answers.text: Send a prophet to warn it

cards.text: Inquire, investigate, interrogate. That's the OPPOSITE of the group chat, where one screenshot and everybody's already mad.

cards.question: True or false: Moses says Israel must act on the report even before it is established with certainty.

cards.text: Once it's certain, Moses says to put the inhabitants of that city to the sword. All its people and livestock are to be devoted to destruction.

cards.question: Israel gathers all the city's plunder in the middle of the public square. Then what does Moses say they do with it?

answers.text: Burn it along with the city

cards.text: Moses says to burn the city and all its plunder "as a whole burnt offering to the LORD your God."

cards.question: True or false: Moses says the burned city may be rebuilt someday.

cards.text: Then Moses says nothing devoted to destruction shall cling to their hands. Not one thing gets kept.

cards.question: If Israel keeps none of the devoted things, what does Moses say the LORD will turn from?
Moses says the LORD will grant Israel mercy, show them compassion and multiply them. He says the LORD will multiply them as…
True or false: Moses says this mercy comes because Israel obeys the LORD, keeps all His commandments and does what is right in His eyes.

cards.text: Keep that oven warm, baker. Moses is NOT done preaching yet.
